Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5316; non-apparent:--that is not manifest.
BiblicalUsage: Not manifest, hidden from sight — nothing is hidden from God, the writer says; all things are naked and opened before him. The word appears only here, at the exact point where the word of God is described as a discerner of thoughts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is both comfort and warning: nothing about me is hidden from the God who loves me.
